item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work uniquely links operando optical microscopy with 3D phase-field modeling to resolve coupled phase-separation and lithium-plating dynamics across particle populations and single particles. Its key novelty is identifying interfacial ohmic resistance as a distinct plating mechanism, plus using thermal activation to probe phase-pathway changes. Significance lies in guiding particle-size-distribution design and fast-charging protocols for graphite electrodes.

item.title: Diagnosing the Role of Mn Additives in Aqueous Zn/MnO 2 Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Operando XRF tracking reveals that Mn²⁺ electrolyte additives improve cycling by supplying extra redox-active Mn during charge, not merely by suppressing cathode dissolution. Capacity fading stems from incomplete MnO₂ dissolution and incomplete Mn²⁺ redeposition, which additives do not mitigate. This underscores the need to directly track Mn²⁺ and address both dissolution and redeposition to improve reversibility.
🏷 aqueous zinc battery · MnO2 cathode · Mn additive · operando XRF · dissolution-redeposition

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using Lewis-acid-induced in situ polymerization of acrylonitrile to create a nanoscale adaptive flexible interphase on halide electrolytes, simultaneously providing ionic conductivity, oxidation stability above 4.8 V, and viscoelasticity. This enables high-voltage all-solid-state batteries with ultrahigh-nickel cathodes to achieve 2000 cycles at 2 C and 9000 cycles at 10 C, offering a broadly applicable interfacial engineering strategy.
🏷 halide electrolyte · all-solid-state battery · flexible interphase · Lewis acid · in situ polymerization

item.title: Locally Competitive Coordination Electrolyte for High‐Voltage Lithium‐Metal Batteries With Ni‐Rich Cathodes
item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in a locally competitive coordination electrolyte using a nitrile primary solvent with ether co-solvent, diluent, and two borate salts, forcing preferential anion decomposition into the SEI. This suppresses parasitic reactions and transition metal shuttling, enabling high-voltage, lean-electrolyte, thin-Li cells with 80% retention over 250 cycles and Ah-level anode-free pouch cells retaining 78.7% over 100 cycles—significant for practical high-energy Li-metal batteries.
🏷 lithium-metal battery · Ni-rich cathode · electrolyte design · borate salts · solid electrolyte interphase

💡 This review uniquely systematizes liquid-phase electrolyte design around solvent-salt-additive components, linking solvation-structure regulation to durable Li metal batteries. It comprehensively consolidates strategies—novel molecular architectures, salt-solvent restructuring, multifunctional additives, (localized) high-concentration electrolytes, and temperature-adaptive formulations—while highlighting emerging directions and remaining challenges, offering actionable guidance to accelerate practical Li metal battery development.

item.title: Engineering Li + Transport in Ni‐Rich Layered Cathodes Toward Homogenization
item.description:

Advanced Materials | ⭐ Review
💡 This review introduces "transport homogenization" as a unifying design principle for Ni-rich layered cathodes, framing degradation as arising from heterogeneous Li+ transport across atomic, structural, and interfacial scales. It reinterprets diverse engineering strategies through this transport-centered lens and highlights characterization approaches, providing a mechanistic framework for rational design of high-energy-density cathodes.
